raw_segments.text: I had at heart a strange and anxious thought. Something had happened which I could not comprehend.
No one knew of or had seen the event but myself. It had taken place the preceding night. Mr.
Rochester that night was absent from home, nor was he yet returned. Business had called
him to a small estate of two or three farms he possessed thirty miles off. Business it
was requisite he should settle in person, previous to his meditated departure from England.
I waited now his return, eager to disburden my mind and to seek of him the solution of the
enigma that perplexed me. Stay till he comes, reader, and when I disclose my secret to him,
